reviews.comment: Dr. Rojas is very knowledgeable and great at explaining. No idea why he is rated so low, one of the best math profs I've ever had. The class moves very fast but it's a 5 week course. Homework is very difficult, but it makes the exams so much easier. If you do the homework, go to office hours, and try to learn the material, it's a solid B at least.

His class is 90 percent graded on exams. You have no idea what you will be tested on for the exam. Homework is unnecessarily tough, and doesn't prepare you for exams. He goes fast in lectures. It is difficult to take notes. His class is tough in the Summer.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Test heavy--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Yes, the class is a bit disorganized and grading is rather slow, but other than that, Dr. Rojas is a really solid professor. He is an expert in cryptography/number theory and can answer just about any question you have. He is a very kind and generous man and grades leniently. Homework is tough, but exams are VERY reasonable. I recommend him for 470

Really unorganized class. Released homework on Friday that was due following Monday. He doesn't release answer keys for any of the homework, so you have to attend the 1 hr weekly zoom session to see if you did the homework correctly. However, you need the 1 hr session to ask questions about hw since the lectures don't relate to the homework at all.
reviews.ratingTags: Tough grader--Get ready to read--Lots of homework

reviews.comment: The online format for this class was very good. The homeworks were hard, but the exams were much easier. He is really helpful during office hours and the exam questions are based off the review. Additionally, he teaches a lot of interesting math content. I would say this is my favorite math course I have ever taken.

His homework is incredibly difficult and time-consuming but only worth 10% of the total grade, exams are slightly less difficult and worth way more. His office hours are helpful, but his lectures are not. Expect to spend more time stressing rather than learning. He's a decent person, but his class is needlessly tough.

I've had the unfortunate experience of taking this class with this professor. I cannot discern his notes from kindergarten scribbles. Unless you plan on attending lecture you won't be able to tell what his notes are over. He doesn't release homework solutions and he only grades part of the homework, leaving the rest up to Godtodecidewhatsright.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: He makes a pretty easy class much more difficult than necessary. Would not recommend because there are much better profs who you'll learn more of what you need from. He's a really nice guy and is always willing to help, it's just a lot of information, and he uses a chalkboard that makes following him super difficult.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--LOTS OF HOMEWORK--Caring

reviews.comment: Kind and approachable professor who always has interesting research to share with his class.  He spoke quickly and said a lot of things, but he would write down on the board everything that was important.  Good at explaining concepts and quick to help in class, office hours, or via email.  He's fantastic, especially once you get used to his style .
He is not very clear when it comes to lectures, very fast pace I'm good in math but he made me hate math not recommending him!
